sloka: स ते जीवित शेषस्य राघवो अन्त करो बली ।पशोः यूप गतस्य इव जीवितम् तव दुर्लभम् ॥३-५६-९॥
transliteration: sa te jīvita śeṣasya rāghavo anta karo balī ।paśoḥ yūpa gatasya iva jīvitam tava durlabham ॥3-56-9॥

translations.english: Powerful Rama will put an end to whatever little life you are left with. Just as a beast tied to a sacrificial post, you will not survive.
